title: Fidelity files Chainlink ETF, Robinhood backs Rialto, CFTC lets crypto count as capital
caption:
deal flow 🏦 btc etfs bled nearly $5b in november, but the builders didn't stop. fidelity filed for a spot chainlink etf (flnk, planned for nasdaq, no staking), joining grayscale's glnk (~$112m) and bitwise's clnk (~$42m). robinhood co-led a $5m seed for onchain trading platform rialto ($600m+ spot volume since july). cftc staff now let derivatives venues count btc and eth (20% haircut) and stablecoins (2%) toward required capital. and galaxy withdrew its 'bear market ended in june' call. which matters most? 👇 not financial advice.
